title: Real-rootedness of Kazhdan--Lusztig and $Z$-polynomials of thagomizer matroids and graphic matroids of $K_{2,n}$
summary: Let $T_n=K_{1,1,n}$, and let $P_n(x)$ denote the Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomial of its graphic matroid. We prove that, whenever $n\ge2$ and $0\leλ\le n/2$, the polynomial $P_n(x)+λx$ has exactly $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ zeros, all of which are negative and simple. In particular, the Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomials of the graphic matroids of $T_n$ and $K_{2,n}$ are real-rooted. We also prove that, for $n\ge2$, the common polynomial $Z_{T_n}(x)=Z_{K_{2,n}}(x)$ has $n+1$ distinct negative zeros.
